module origen_016149(
    input wire reset,
    input wire [5:0] opcode,
    output reg reg_dst,
    output reg mem_to_reg,
    output reg mem_read,
    output reg mem_write,
    output reg alu_src,
    output reg reg_write,
    output reg branch,
    output reg jump,
    output reg [1:0] alu_op
);

always @(*) begin
    if (reset) begin
        reg_dst = 0;
        mem_to_reg = 0;
        mem_read = 0;
        mem_write = 0;
        alu_src = 0;
        reg_write = 0;
        branch = 0;
        jump = 0;
        alu_op = 2'b00;
    end else begin
        case (opcode)
            6'b000000: begin // R-type
                reg_dst = 1;
                mem_to_reg = 0;
                mem_read = 0;
                mem_write = 0;
                alu_src = 0;
                reg_write = 1;
                branch = 0;
                jump = 0;
                alu_op = 2'b10;
            end
            6'b001000: begin // I-type
                reg_dst = 0;
                mem_to_reg = 0;
                mem_read = 0;
                mem_write = 0;
                alu_src = 1;
                reg_write = 1;
                branch = 0;
                jump = 0;
                alu_op = 2'b00;
            end
            6'b100011: begin // Load word
                reg_dst = 0;
                mem_to_reg = 1;
                mem_read = 1;
                mem_write = 0;
                alu_src = 1;
                reg_write = 1;
                branch = 0;
                jump = 0;
                alu_op = 2'b00;
            end
            6'b101011: begin // Store word
                reg_dst = 0;
                mem_to_reg = 0;
                mem_read = 0;
                mem_write = 1;
                alu_src = 1;
                reg_write = 0;
                branch = 0;
                jump = 0;
                alu_op = 2'b00;
            end
            6'b000010: begin // Jump
                reg_dst = 0;
                mem_to_reg = 0;
                mem_read = 0;
                mem_write = 0;
                alu_src = 0;
                reg_write = 0;
                branch = 0;
                jump = 1;
                alu_op = 2'b00;
            end
            6'b000100: begin // Branch
                reg_dst = 0;
                mem_to_reg = 0;
                mem_read = 0;
                mem_write = 0;
                alu_src = 0;
                reg_write = 0;
                branch = 1;
                jump = 0;
                alu_op = 2'b01;
            end
            6'b001100: begin // ANDI
                reg_dst = 0;
                mem_to_reg = 0;
                mem_read = 0;
                mem_write = 0;
                alu_src = 1;
                reg_write = 1;
                branch = 0;
                jump = 0;
                alu_op = 2'b11;
            end
            6'b110000: begin // Custom R-type with immediate
                reg_dst = 1;
                mem_to_reg = 0;
                mem_read = 0;
                mem_write = 0;
                alu_src = 1;
                reg_write = 1;
                branch = 0;
                jump = 0;
                alu_op = 2'b10;
            end
            default: begin
                reg_dst = 0;
                mem_to_reg = 0;
                mem_read = 0;
                mem_write = 0;
                alu_src = 0;
                reg_write = 0;
                branch = 0;
                jump = 0;
                alu_op = 2'b00;
            end
        endcase
    end
end

endmodule
